frb.charm.frost_chime.title: Winter's Ward
frb.charm.frost_chime.line1: · Active skill (default V) records position, health, hunger and all effects; use again within 30s to rewind
frb.charm.frost_chime.line2: · Shift-right-click toggles auto-rewind on timeout; rewind or timeout starts a 30s cooldown
frb.charm.ember_vine.title: Gift of Ashes
frb.charm.ember_vine.line1: · Immune to fire and lava; walk upon lava
frb.charm.ember_vine.line2: · Your attacks brand the target with the Flamebloom Mark
frb.charm.ember_vine.line3: · Attacking a fully marked target detonates the mark for heavy damage
frb.charm.sky_tear.title: Tear of the Sky
frb.charm.sky_tear.line1: · Fire will never set you alight
frb.charm.sky_tear.line2: · Every 2s repairs %s durability on items in inventory and armor slots
frb.charm.sky_tear.line3: · Walk on water; gain Water Breathing and Night Vision while submerged
frb.charm.sky_tear.line4: · In rain, heal and cleanse a negative effect every 3s
frb.charm.forest_whisper.title: Call of Life
frb.charm.forest_whisper.line2: · Increased max health and mining speed
frb.charm.forest_whisper.line3: · Standing still keeps nearby crops growing
frb.charm.forest_whisper.line4: · Nearby animal births raise your villager reputation
frb.charm.astral_bloom.title: Walker of the Void
frb.charm.astral_bloom.line6: · Active skill (default G): blink 18 blocks toward your cursor (30s cooldown)
frb.charm.black_spirit.title: Plague Whisper
frb.charm.black_spirit.line2: · Hostile mobs around you are plagued by the Black Death
frb.charm.sky_pillar.title: Wings of the Firmament
frb.charm.sealed: Sealed by the World Flower — defeat the Boss to restore

frb.eternal.title: Seven as One
frb.eternal.line1: · Aggregates the effects and attributes of all seven charms
frb.eternal.line2: · Immune to fall, drowning, fire, poison, wither and all environmental damage
frb.eternal.line3: · Permanent Night Vision, Water Breathing and creative flight; +4 enchant levels
frb.eternal.line4: · [Terminus Wreath] press R: a 32-block blessing domain — Regen II, Absorption V, Resistance IV, +700%% final damage
frb.eternal.acquire: Sole way to obtain: defeat Frilias in phase seven and she will hand it to you

frb.bountiful.line1: While held: faster regeneration; volley damage scales with attack power and engraved rites
frb.bountiful.line2: Hold right-click: scatter homing petals and leaves; each active flower charm boosts fire rate

frb.jei.cond.bucket: The lava bucket offering returns the empty bucket

frb.jei.info.altar: Altar of the seven floral rites: right-click with a Formless Seed to condense the matching flower seed.
frb.jei.info.formless: Formless Seed: the embryo of every rite. It resonates with altitude, weather and nearby blocks to condense into a flower's seed.
frb.jei.info.realm: Seed of the World Flower: blooms slowly (bonemeal works); right-click the full bloom to enter the Eternal Garden and challenge Frilias.
frb.jei.info.pedestal: Floral Pedestal: right-click with an item to place an offering, empty-hand to retrieve. Pedestals within 8 blocks of the altar supply the rite first. Bonemealing grass has a small chance to sprout one.

advancements.floral_rite_bloom_curios.fl: Win the challenge against the Spirit of All Flowers.
advancements.floral_rite_bloom_curios.ch: Pick up a bell that rings in the first snow.
Pick up a flame that refuses to die out.
Catch a tear fallen from the sky.
Hear the forest whisper through its vines.
Pick a flower that belongs to the far side of the stars.
Make a pact with the breath of withering.
Climb the unfettered wind that reaches the heavens.
Gather all seven flower spirits and complete the floral rite.
Obtain any one of the seven flower spirit charms.
advancements.floral_rite_bloom_curios.wo: Witness the awakening of the World Flower.
